items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is a true pregame workout decision vs Cowboys; team not counting on him playing.
items.why: Pregame workout to determine availability; source says true GTD but team not counting on him.
items.implication: High risk sit in fantasy; monitor warmups closely.
items.opportunity: If OUT, boosts other Ravens WRs like Bateman/Likely targets.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (hip, Q) plans to play and is good to go vs Cardinals.
items.why: Plans to play per source; Rapoport confirms good to go.
items.implication: Start with confidence; reverse any prior sit thoughts.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in favorable spot.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (ankle) should play today; Xavier Legette (knee) GTD.
items.implication: Start if rostered; solid target share.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams OUT for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent back at practice, trending to start.
items.implication: Sit Williams; Bears pass game downgrade for Odunze/Moore etc.
items.opportunity: Bagent checkdowns may help RBs/TEs more.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley and WR DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go for MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Officially removed from injury report after stinger (Barkley) concerns.
items.implication: Lock both into lineups for MNF.
items.opportunity: Full snap shares; no role reduction expected.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 3 vs Colts.
items.why: Officially ruled out, second straight week.
items.implication: Sit; elevates TE Dalton Schultz heavily.
items.opportunity: Schultz 28-30% target share last week without him; Colts allow TE yards.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); Mariota starts.
items.implication: Sit Daniels; McLaurin still viable but downgraded matchup/volume risk.
items.opportunity: Mariota game script may increase McLaurin target share historically.

items.text: Levitan projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite Q tags; hopes early clarity on Flowers (ham), DJ Moore (shoulder), AD Mitchell.
items.why: ETR internal projections have them playing; DFS implications large.
items.implication: Trust projections over Q label for these; start if projected.
items.opportunity: Warren lead back/checkdowns with Dowdle OUT; Bowers full TE role.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: IN (Dobbins, Harvey, Nabers, Etienne, Price, Darnold); Q (Bowers, Flowers, Evans, DJ Moore, Warren, Pittman, Parkinson); D (Nacua); OUT (Daniels, Dart, Collins, Dowdle, Pierce, Brooks, Iosivas, Coleman, Njoku).
items.why: Comprehensive Fri list of designations for Sunday slate.
items.implication: Parse for start/sit and beneficiaries; monitor for changes.
items.opportunity: Clear OUT opens roles (e.g. Warren for Dowdle, Schultz for Collins, Hubbard for Brooks).

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle OUT; elevates Jaylen Warren to lead role with checkdown upside.
items.why: Listed OUT on ETR comprehensive report; confirmed in Schefter out list.
items.implication: Warren clear RB1 for Steelers; strong start.
items.opportunity: Lead carries + pass-game work; Levitan notes lead+checkdowns.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua DOUBTFUL (hip); not expected to play Sunday night vs Broncos.
items.why: ETR D tag; McVay comments and reports confirm lean out.
items.implication: Sit; boosts other Rams pass-catchers like Adams/Parkinson if in.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to Davante Adams, Kyren involvement.

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks to IR/OUT; Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back with AJ Dillon backup.
items.why: Expected IR; ETR lists OUT; Berry notes lead role locked for Hubbard.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop, Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both weeks, RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry LOVES Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share w/ Collins out, IND allows TE yds).
items.why: Volume + matchup edges; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT.
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz TE1 upside.

items.text: Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches, tough run D) and Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd down snaps).
items.implication: Sit or fade in favor of handcuffs/alts.
items.opportunity: Henderson rising post-Stevenson fumble; Etienne limited.
items.conflict: ETR has Etienne IN but role still split.

items.text: Post-Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led NE with 65% snaps and 16-5 touch edge rest of game; gap narrowed but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead Wk3.
items.opportunity: Potential committee or lead if Stevenson struggles again.

items.text: Schultz 28-30% tgt share/routes w/ Collins out; London avg 20+ PPR, 35% tgts, 97 yds in 12 games w/ Penix.
items.why: Clear opportunity spikes from teammate/QB contexts.
items.implication: Schultz TE1 play; London locked WR1.
items.opportunity: Target/route shares elite in those spots.
